Assignment Title: Abstract Class_Student Fee Management System  Problem

Assignment Question:
A university is developing a Student Fee Management System to calculate the fees payable by different types of students. Every student has common details such as name, roll number, and course, but the fee calculation varies depending on the type of student. A regular student pays the full tuition fee, whereas a scholarship student receives a discount based on the scholarship percentage. An abstract class Student is used to represent the common structure of all students. The subclasses RegularStudent and ScholarshipStudent implement their own versions of the calculateFee() method. The system should validate all input values before creating the appropriate student object and calculating the final fee.
 Class Design
Abstract Class: Student
Data Members: name, rollNumber, course, tuitionFee
Methods:
- Student(String name, int rollNumber, String course, double tuitionFee) – Constructor
- abstract double calculateFee() – Calculates the fee according to the student type
- void display() – Displays student details and calculated fee
Class: RegularStudent
Data Members: Inherits all data members from Student
Methods:
- Constructor
- double calculateFee() – Returns the full tuition fee
Class: ScholarshipStudent
Data Members:
- Inherits all data members from Student
- double scholarshipPercentage
Methods:
- Constructor
- double calculateFee() – Calculates the fee after applying the scholarship discount
Class: Main
Methods:
- main() – Reads input, performs validation directly using if conditions, creates the appropriate object, and displays the result.
Input Validation Conditions
The following conditions should be satisfied:
1.    Student type must be either Regular or Scholarship.
2.    Student name must not be empty.
3.    Roll number must be greater than 0.
4.    Course must not be empty.
5.    Tuition fee must be greater than 0.
6.    For a scholarship student, scholarship percentage must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
7.    All validation is performed directly in main() using if conditions.
8.    No separate methods are used for checking validation conditions.
Input Format
The input consists of:
Student Type
Name
Roll Number
Course
Tuition Fee
For a Scholarship student, an additional input is provided:
Scholarship Percentage
Input for Regular Student
Regular
name
roll number

tuition fee
Input for Scholarship Student

course

scholarship percentage
Output Format
For valid input:
Name: <name>
Roll Number: <roll number>
Course: <course>
Fee: <calculated fee>
For invalid input:
Invalid Input
6. Sample Input and Output
Sample Input 1
Regular
Mannan
101
Computer Science
50000
Sample Output 1
Name: Mannan
Roll Number: 101
Course: Computer Science
Fee: 50000.0
